en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a Spanish‑Mission style arched bell wall and courtyard. Multiple women in long Edwardian-era dresses pose on and around the arches and in the bell niches. The building behind has stucco walls, red‑tile roofs, and arcaded balconies, suggesting a California mission‑inspired hotel or complex. A caption strip at the bottom reads "RIVERSIDE BELLES WELCOMING PRESIDENT ROOSEVELT," and another note credits "PHOTO BY SUNSET PHOTO ENG. CO., S.F." A vertical German phrase appears along the left border.
